<style>
#macro-dashboard {
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: inherit;
}

  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35em 1.15em;
  margin: 0 0 1.25em;
  font-size: .85em;
}

  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:hover {
  border-bottom-color: currentColor;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-update-note {
  margin: -.45em 0 1.25em;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section {
  margin: 0 0 1.6em;
  scroll-margin-top: 1em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section > .macro-heading {
  margin: 0 0 .65em;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section-intro {
  margin: 0 0 .75em;
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-panel {
  margin: 0 0 .85em;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 170px;
  column-gap: 16px;
  row-gap: 0;
  align-items: start;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 352px;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-figure {
  min-width: 0;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 2;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 14px 0 60px;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-align: left;
  -webkit-user-select: text;
  user-select: text;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-canvas {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents {
  margin: 0 14px .25em 52px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #222;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents.has-two-columns {
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - 66px);
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents.is-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  border: 1px solid #000;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - var(--macro-margin-left, 60px) - var(--macro-margin-right, 14px));
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-title {
  margin: 0 0 3px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 3px 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-items.is-two-column {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, max-content);
  grid-auto-flow: column;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(4, auto);
  gap: 4px 10px;
  align-items: center;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-president-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-president-swatch {
  display: inline-block;
  flex: 0 0 10px;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: .75em;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-top: var(--macro-plot-top, 14px);
  font-size: .85em;
  text-align: left;
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 2;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar p,
#macro-dashboard .macro-info,
#macro-dashboard .macro-info p,
#macro-dashboard .macro-source,
#macro-dashboard .macro-key-label {
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button,
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: .4em .65em;
  border: 1px solid #bbb;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: none;
  background: #fff;
  color: #333;
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button:hover,
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary:hover {
  background: #f3f3f3;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button:disabled {
  opacity: .5;
  cursor: wait;
}

#macro-dashboard :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #555;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary {
  list-style: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary::after {
  content: " ▾";
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about[open] summary::after {
  content: " ▴";
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 10;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  right: 0;
  width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 48px));
  max-height: min(72vh, 520px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 1em;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #0002;
  color: #333;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info p {
  margin: 0 0 .75em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info .macro-series {
  padding-bottom: .65em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info .macro-original {
  display: inline;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest {
  display: grid;
  gap: .25em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest-value {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-indicators {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-title {
  margin: .1em 0 .35em;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-keys {
  display: grid;
  gap: .4em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5em;
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample {
  display: inline-block;
  flex: 0 0 26px;
  width: 26px;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 1.6px solid #111;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-label {
  min-width: 0;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample.is-bar,
#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample[data-kind="bar"] {
  height: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #111;
  background: #111;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-source {
  margin: .1em 0 0;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .95em;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-source a {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-status {
  margin: .4em 0;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .85em;
}

#macro-dashboard [hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {

  }

  }

}

  #macro-dashboard .macro-info {

  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-source,
  #macro-dashboard .macro-indicators {
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-keys {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: .35em .8em;
  }
}

/* Compact contents: append after the original dashboard styles. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
  margin: 0 0 1.25em;
  padding: 12px 16px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #fafafa;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-contents-label {
  margin: 0 0 .5em;
  color: #666;
  font-size: .75em;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .35em 1.5em;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: .9em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5em minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: .45em;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: .45em 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: inherit;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-decoration: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-number {
  padding-top: .06em;
  color: #777;
  font-size: .85em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy strong {
  display: block;
  color: #222;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy > span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .2em;
  color: #666;
  font-size: .83em;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:hover .macro-nav-copy strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: .16em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #555;
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.25em;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 440px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: .1em;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav a {
    padding: .4em 0;
  }
}

/* Subtitles share the chart-title inset on desktop and mobile. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-subtitle {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  padding: 0 14px 0 60px;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #555;
  text-align: left;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators {
  z-index: 3;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  color: #222;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  text-align: left;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators .macro-key {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators .macro-key-label {
  white-space: nowrap;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

/* The shared header row lets every control begin at the plot's data edge. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 0 16px;
}

/* Inset legend boxes appear only after their geometry has been calculated. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar > .macro-indicators {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
    padding: 10px 0 14px;
  }
}

/* Mobile keeps the desktop visual language with readable legends and controls. */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
    font-size: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button,
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about {
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about[open] {
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about .macro-info {
    position: static;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    max-height: 60vh;
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-source {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
}


/* One compact layout for all figures; the renderer aligns both heading insets. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-section {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  scroll-margin-top: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section > .macro-heading {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-intro {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-panel {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  scroll-margin-top: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 160px;
  column-gap: 12px;
  row-gap: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
  padding: 4px 0 3px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-subtitle {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
  height: 312px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
  gap: 8px;
  padding-top: var(--macro-plot-top, 8px);
  font-size: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-source {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-status[hidden] {
  margin: 0;
}

/* Read section groups across rows: 01–03, 04–06, then 07–09. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents-label {
  display: list-item;
  margin: 0;
  list-style-position: inside;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents[open] > .macro-contents-label {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-auto-flow: row;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 8px 14px;
  columns: auto;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-section {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto;
  align-content: start;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  gap: 2px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: 4px;
  min-height: 2.6em;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-heading strong {
  color: #222;
  font-weight: 600;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-heading .macro-nav-number {
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-plots {
  align-self: start;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-plots > li {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 47px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 3px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1px 0;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-roman {
  color: #666;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot:hover > span:last-child,
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading:hover strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot > span:last-child {
  font-size: 9px !important;
}
  
/* Sharing the heading track aligns the first chart in every section of a row,
   including when a longer section heading wraps onto an additional line. */
@supports (grid-template-rows: subgrid) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    row-gap: 6px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-toc-section {
    grid-row: span 2;
    grid-template-rows: subgrid;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
    min-height: 0;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 840px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
    min-height: 0;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
    padding: 8px 10px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
  }

  }
}


/* Independent native disclosures preserve the existing section hierarchy. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-group {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-summary {
  display: list-item;
  list-style-position: inside;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-summary > .macro-heading {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-group:not([open]) > .macro-section-summary {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-body {
  min-width: 0;
}


/* Municipal figures retain the same heading, sidebar and compact controls. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-layout {grid-template-columns:minmax(0,520px) 160px;max-width:692px;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart {width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:220px;touch-action:pan-y;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart svg {display:block;width:100%;height:auto;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart [data-municipality] {cursor:pointer;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-control {display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;max-width:100%;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-control select {width:160px;max-width:100%;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:#333;font:inherit;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-title,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-subtitle {padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-detail,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-coverage {margin:3px 12px 0;font-family:"Times New Roman",Times,serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-detail {min-height:2.7em;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-reference {margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-announcement {position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}
@media(max-width:600px){
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-layout {grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);max-width:none;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-control {flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:6px;}

    <div id="panel-fig1g" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="VII. Consumption, investment and net exports">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig1g" class="macro-plot-title">VII. Consumption, investment and net exports</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig1g" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Household and government consumption, fixed investment (left); net exports proxy (right). Indices: 2019 = 100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig1g" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig1g" aria-busy="true" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig1g"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig1g" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig1g" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig1g" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Households</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – consumo das famílias</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22110</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Government</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – consumo do governo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22111" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22111</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gross fixed capital formation</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – formação bruta de capital fixo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22113" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22113</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Net exports (2019-weighted proxy)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Exportações líquidas de bens e serviços – indicador calculado com pesos de 2019</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22114" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22114</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22115" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22115</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p>Consumption and investment are seasonally adjusted quarterly volume indices from the national accounts, distributed through the SGS.</p>
            <p>Each consumption and investment series is divided by its own average across the four quarters of 2019 and multiplied by 100.</p>
            <p>Net exports are a calculated volume-balance proxy. The export and import volume indices are separately divided by their own 2019 averages, then weighted by average quarterly current-price exports and imports in 2019, subtracted, and rebased to average 2019 = 100.</p>
            <p>The fixed 2019 weights are BRL 260,890.25 million for exports and BRL 272,794.50 million for imports, from IBGE SIDRA table 1846. The reference balance is −BRL 11,904.25 million per quarter.</p>
            <p>Net exports index = 100 × [260,890.25 × (export volume / its 2019 average) − 272,794.50 × (import volume / its 2019 average)] / (260,890.25 − 272,794.50).</p>
            <p>The 2019 reference balance is negative: a higher net-exports index represents a lower constructed balance; a negative index represents a positive constructed balance.</p>
            <p>All four series have an average of 100 in 2019. The indices compare changes over time, not absolute sizes or GDP shares. They are not additive and do not sum to GDP; the net-exports indicator is not an official chained-volume aggregate or the current-account balance.</p>
            <p>Investment is gross fixed capital formation (GFCF), including public and private investment in fixed assets; it excludes changes in inventories.</p>
            <p>Native quarterly dates and observations are retained. Export and import inputs are already seasonally adjusted; no further adjustment, interpolation or smoothing is applied.</p>
            <p>Consumption and investment use the left axis; net exports use the right axis. Both axes are indices with average 2019 = 100, and the reference value of 100 is aligned at the same height. The two axis scales differ.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig1g" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig1g" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig1g" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22110</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22111" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22111</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22113" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22113</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22114" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22114</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22115" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22115</strong></a>; 2019 weights: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/1846" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE SIDRA 1846</a>. Author’s calculations.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig1g" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig1h" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="VIII. Minimum wage: nominal and real">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig1h" class="macro-plot-title">VIII. Minimum wage: nominal and real</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Monthly minimum wage; real values in December 2024 BRL.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig1h" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig1h" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig1h" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig1h" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig1h" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Nominal minimum wage</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Salário mínimo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1619</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Real minimum wage — December 2024 prices</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Salário mínimo deflacionado pelo IPCA</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1619</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>The nominal line is the statutory monthly minimum wage published in SGS 1619, in current BRL.</p>
            <p>The real line is calculated from the same nominal series using the monthly IPCA percentage changes in SGS 433. Monthly rates are compounded into a price index; they are not added.</p>
            <p>Real wage at month t = nominal wage at t × compounded IPCA index in December 2024 / compounded IPCA index at t.</p>
            <p>The price reference is December 2024. Nominal and real values therefore coincide in that month. The two lines show BRL per month, with the real line expressed in December 2024 purchasing power.</p>
            <p>The graph starts in January 1996. Observations dated after the current month are excluded, including any pre-published future minimum-wage observations.</p>
            <p>The real line ends at the latest month for which both a nominal wage and a published IPCA observation exist. No inflation values are forecast or carried forward.</p>
            <p>Native monthly observations are retained without additional seasonal adjustment or smoothing.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig1h" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig1h" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig1h" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1619</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-gdp" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Annual municipal gross domestic product valued at current prices. Source: IBGE GDP of Municipalities, reference 2010, SIDRA table 5938, variable 37. The source unit is BRL thousand; values are multiplied by 1,000 to obtain BRL. The colourbar uses BRL billion for compact labels; municipality details show BRL.</p><p>The embedded observations refer to 2023, the latest available year in the source API when verified. The publication period was revised on 19 December 2025. Future updates select the latest published observation year from the API.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Colours use log(1 + BRL) spacing on each side of the national municipal median. Red indicates lower GDP and green higher GDP. This scale retains contrast across municipalities of very different economic size.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Newly published periods and revisions appear after a successful source check.</p>
              <p>Verified snapshots and optional browser storage keep the last valid published dataset available during a temporary API failure. The shared scheduler retries failed checks.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2023. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-29.</div>
            </div>
          </details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/5938" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GDP of Municipalities</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/docs/malhas?versao=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">2022 boundaries</a>.</p>
        </aside>

    <div id="panel-map-income" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-income">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">

          <p id="subtitle-map-income" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Mean monthly nominal household income per person; BRL, Census 2022.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-income" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-income" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-income" aria-busy="true"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-income" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Mean monthly nominal household income per capita, in BRL of the reference year. The source includes residents in occupied permanent private households under the IBGE household-income definition; it covers all ages.</p><p>Source: IBGE Population Census, SIDRA table 10295, variable 13431. The selection uses totals for sex, race/colour and age. The embedded 2022 snapshot uses preliminary sample results.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Colours vary linearly on each side of the national municipal median. Red indicates lower income and green higher income.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Newly published periods and revisions appear after a successful source check.</p>
              <p>Verified snapshots and optional browser storage keep the last valid published dataset available during a temporary API failure. The shared scheduler retries failed checks.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-29.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-income">State
            <select id="state-map-income" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select>
          </label>
          <button id="download-map-income" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Red: lower · green: higher.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10295" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Population Census</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/docs/malhas?versao=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">2022 boundaries</a>.</p>

      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2d" class="macro-plot-title">XV. Public debt (% of GDP)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Net public sector debt and gross general government debt have different institutional coverage.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2d" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2d" aria-busy="true"></div>

            </div>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2d" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Net public sector debt</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Dívida Líquida do Setor Público (% PIB) – Total – setor público consolidado</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4513" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4513</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gross general government debt</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Dívida bruta do governo geral (% PIB) – metodologia utilizada a partir de 2008</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13762" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13762</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Both lines are debt stocks expressed as a percentage of GDP, plotted on the same vertical scale starting at 20% of GDP. They are not accumulated 12-month flows.</p>
            <p>Net public sector debt covers the consolidated public sector, while gross general government debt covers general government under the BCB methodology. Their institutional coverage differs; the gap between the lines is not simply government assets.</p>
            <p>Gross general government debt uses the methodology adopted from 2008, with observations available from December 2006. No earlier values are imputed.</p>
            <p>The upper axis limit adapts to both series and is rounded up to the next ten percentage points.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>

  <section id="section-credit-bndes" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-credit-bndes">
    <details id="group-credit-bndes" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-credit-bndes" class="macro-heading">Credit and household finances</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <p class="macro-section-intro">BNDES is Brazil’s federal development bank.</p>
    <div id="panel-fig3a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XVI. Credit and BNDES lending (% of GDP)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig3a" class="macro-plot-title">XVI. Credit and BNDES lending (% of GDP)</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig3a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig3a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Total credit / GDP</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Saldo da carteira de crédito em relação ao PIB</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20622" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20622</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>BNDES total lending / GDP</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Desembolsos do sistema BNDES – Total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7415" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7415</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4380</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) is Brazil’s federal public development bank.</p>
            <p>The BNDES curve reproduces Fig. 3(a) in the supplied Python script: the 12-observation sum of SGS 7415, divided by the 12-month sum of GDP (4380), multiplied by 100.</p>
            <p>SGS 7415 contains year-to-date disbursements. Summing these observations reproduces the original-script indicator; it is not the total of monthly disbursements over the previous 12 months.</p>
            <p>The sector chart below retains the monthly-flow calculation described in its own notes.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig3a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig3a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Debt service / monthly income</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Comprometimento de renda das famílias com o serviço da dívida com o Sistema Financeiro Nacional – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29034" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29034</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Household indebtedness is the outstanding debt stock with the national financial system divided by household income accumulated over the previous twelve months.</p>
            <p>The debt-service burden relates expected interest and amortization payments to monthly household income, published as a seasonally adjusted three-month moving average.</p>
            <p>Both series are percentages, but their income denominators differ. They are plotted on one common scale without additional moving averages.</p>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Imports</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Importação de bens – Balanço de Pagamentos – mensal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22709" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22709</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>

            <p>Monthly flows of goods exports, imports and the trade balance, compiled under the BPM6 balance-of-payments framework.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig6c" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXI. Labor force, employment and unemployment">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig6c" class="macro-plot-title">XXXI. Labor force, employment and unemployment</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">PNAD Continuous Survey, moving-quarter estimates; millions of people.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig6c" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig6c" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig6c" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig6c" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Labor force — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População na força de trabalho – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Employed people — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas ocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Unemployed people — right axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas desocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>The three series are estimates from the IBGE Continuous National Household Sample Survey (PNAD Continuous Survey), distributed through the SGS, for people aged 14 or older.</p>
            <p>Labor force and employed people use the left axis, fixed from 80 to 110 million people. Unemployed people use the right axis, fixed from 0 to 30 million people.</p>
            <p>The published SGS unit is thousands of people. Each value is divided by 1,000 to display millions of people; it is not divided by one million.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the moving three-month reference period ending in that month. These are not counts for an isolated month. No additional moving average, seasonal adjustment or interpolation is applied.</p>
            <p>Labor force equals employed plus unemployed people, apart from rounding in the published series. The first observation is the moving quarter ending in March 2012; the x axis begins in January 2012.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig6c" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig6c" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig6c" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ibge.gov.br/estatisticas/sociais/trabalho/9173-pnad-continua.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE – PNAD Continuous Survey</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig6c" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>


    <div id="panel-fig6d" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXII. Informality by age group">

          <p id="subtitle-fig6d" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Quarterly informal employment rates within each age group; Overall covers employed people aged 14 or older.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig6d" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig6d" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig6d" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig6d" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig6d" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6d" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Overall</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de Informalidade (IBGE/Pnad Contínua)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>14–17 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 14 a 17 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1417&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1417</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>18–24 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 18 a 24 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>25–39 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 25 a 39 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>40–59 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 40 a 59 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>60 years and over</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - mais de 60 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_60M&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_60M</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p>Quarterly estimates for Brazil from the IBGE PNAD Continuous Survey, distributed through Ipeadata. Values are percentages as published, without additional scaling or smoothing.</p>
            <p>Informality rates are calculated among employed people aged 14 or older. Each subgroup rate uses the employed population within that subgroup as its denominator.</p>
            <p>Under the IBGE definition, informal employment includes private-sector employees and domestic workers without a signed work card, employers and own-account workers without a registered business (CNPJ), and contributing family workers.</p>
            <p>The Overall line uses the national informality rate and is identical in both panels. It is shown as a thicker black line.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the reference calendar quarter, rather than a moving quarter. Lines connect available quarterly observations; no missing-quarter values are created.</p>
            <p>The final IBGE age category is 60 years and over. The Ipeadata series title says ‘mais de 60 anos’; the displayed category follows the IBGE age classification.</p>
            <p>Age categories: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/4094/metadados" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE PNAD Continuous metadata</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig6d" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig6d" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig6d" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ibge.gov.br/estatisticas/sociais/trabalho/9173-pesquisa-nacional-por-amostra-de-domicilios-continua-trimestral.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE – PNAD Continuous Survey</a>, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>. National quarterly estimates.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig6d" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Overall</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de Informalidade (IBGE/Pnad Contínua)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>White</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - brancos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_BRA&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_BRA</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Men</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - homem (IBGE/Pnad Contínua)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_HOM&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_HOM</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Women</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - mulher (IBGE/Pnad Contínua)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_MUL&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_MUL</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Brown (pardo)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - pardos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_PRD&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_PRD</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Black (preto)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - pretos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_NEG&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_NEG</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p>Quarterly estimates for Brazil from the IBGE PNAD Continuous Survey, distributed through Ipeadata. Values are percentages as published, without additional scaling or smoothing.</p>
            <p>Informality rates are calculated among employed people aged 14 or older. Each subgroup rate uses the employed population within that subgroup as its denominator.</p>
            <p>Under the IBGE definition, informal employment includes private-sector employees and domestic workers without a signed work card, employers and own-account workers without a registered business (CNPJ), and contributing family workers.</p>
            <p>The Overall line uses the national informality rate and is identical in both panels. It is shown as a thicker black line.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the reference calendar quarter, rather than a moving quarter. Lines connect available quarterly observations; no missing-quarter values are created.</p>
            <p>White, Brown (pardo), and Black (preto) follow the IBGE self-identified race/colour categories. Black (preto) is the specific preto category; the pardo category is shown separately.</p>
            <p>The sex and race/colour groups overlap. These lines describe separate breakdowns of employment and are not added together.</p>

  <section id="section-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-inequality-poverty">
    <details id="group-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-inequality-poverty" class="macro-heading">Inequality and poverty</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">

    <div id="panel-fig7a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXIV. Income inequality: Gini index">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7a" class="macro-plot-title">XXXIV. Income inequality: Gini index</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Annual estimates; PNAD and PNAD Continuous series linked by Ipea.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gini index</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Coeficiente de Gini da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_GINI&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_GINI</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The source reports Gini on a 0–100 scale. Values are divided by 100 to display the conventional 0–1 scale; lower values indicate less inequality.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p id="subtitle-fig7b" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Income share of the richest 10% divided by the income share of the poorest 40%.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Palma ratio</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Razão de Palma da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PALMA&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PALMA</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The Palma ratio compares the two groups’ shares of total income. Higher values indicate greater income concentration.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig7c" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXVI. Poverty and extreme poverty">
      <div class="macro-layout">

          <p id="subtitle-fig7c" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Poverty: $8.30/day; extreme poverty: $3.00/day, per person in 2021 PPP international dollars.</p>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$8,30</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE830&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE830</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Extreme poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$3,00</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE300&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE300</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>Poverty and extreme poverty are the percentages of the total population with per capita household income below the respective line.</p>
            <p>Both thresholds use 2021 purchasing power parities (PPP). In average 2024 prices, the thresholds correspond to BRL 738 and BRL 267 per person per month, respectively.</p>
            <p>The extreme-poverty population is included in the poverty population; the two series are not added together.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>

            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7c" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig7c" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: Ipea / IBGE household surveys, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE830&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_PERCPOBRE830</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE300&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNADS_PERCPOBRE300</a>.</p>

          <details id="info-fig7d" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Benefits (December)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - número de benefícios em dezembro</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;FAM_PBF&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>FAM_PBF</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Bolsa Família is Brazil’s cash transfer programme for low-income families. The administrative series includes the Auxílio Brasil period and subsequent return to the Bolsa Família name.</p>
            <p>The source is MDS administrative records obtained from the federal Transparency Portal. Suspended benefits are excluded.</p>
            <p>Each annual observation is the number of benefits in December of the reference year. The count is divided by one million for display.</p>
            <p>The API labels annual observations by year. Each count is positioned in December, its reference month, to align with the government-period shading.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig7e" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXVIII. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7e" class="macro-plot-title">XXXVIII. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7e" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil’s cash transfer programme; monthly totals. Constant prices: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span> (IPCA).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7e" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7e" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7e" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7e" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7e" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Current prices</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA-adjusted</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA price adjustment</strong><br>Monthly consumer price inflation, BCB–SGS <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.</p>
            <p>Bolsa Família is Brazil’s cash transfer programme for low-income families. The administrative series includes the Auxílio Brasil period and subsequent return to the Bolsa Família name.</p>
            <p>The source is MDS administrative records obtained from the federal Transparency Portal. Suspended benefits are excluded.</p>
            <p>Current-price transfers are the published monthly totals. The source unit is BRL thousands, divided by one million to display BRL billions.</p>
            <p>The constant-price series uses the compounded monthly IPCA changes from BCB–SGS 433. Each amount is multiplied by the ratio of the price index in the reference month to the index in the observation month.</p>
            <p>Price reference: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span>, the latest month jointly available in the transfers and IPCA series. The reference updates automatically when both sources contain a newer month.</p>
            <p>Only months with complete IPCA coverage are converted to constant prices. The original monthly frequency is retained.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7e" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig7e" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig7e" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: MDS / Transparency Portal, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">VAL_PBF12</a>. Price adjustment: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 433 (IPCA)</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig7e" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div id="panel-map-pbf" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-pbf">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-map-pbf" class="macro-plot-title">XXXIX. Bolsa Família benefits by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-pbf" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil’s cash transfer programme; number of benefits paid in December 2025.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-pbf" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-pbf" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-pbf" aria-busy="true"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-pbf" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p>Number of Bolsa Família benefits paid in December of each reference year, excluding suspended benefits. This is the published absolute benefit count.</p><p>Source: MDS administrative records / federal Transparency Portal, via Ipeadata series FAM_PBF. The annual API date is labelled January, but the substantive reference is December; the map and download use that December reference.</p><p>Larger counts also reflect municipality size. The map represents administrative benefit counts. New annual observations appear only when their December reference is available.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Only this map reverses the palette: green indicates fewer benefits and red more benefits. Log(1 + count) spaces the colours on each side of the national municipal median, retaining contrast across the long upper tail. All displayed counts remain in their original units.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values are grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Newly published periods and revisions appear after a successful source check.</p>
              <p>Verified snapshots and optional browser storage keep the last valid published dataset available during a temporary API failure. The shared scheduler retries failed checks.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2025. Embedded snapshot verified 2026-10-29.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-pbf">State
            <select id="state-map-pbf" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select>
          </label>
          <button id="download-map-pbf" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Green: fewer benefits · red: more benefits.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: MDS / Transparency Portal, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=290547434" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>. Boundaries: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/docs/malhas?versao=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE 2022</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-map-pbf" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
