    } else {
      item.mode = spec.marker ? "lines+markers" : "lines";
      item.line = { color: spec.color || "#111", width: Math.max(1.3, spec.width || 1), dash: spec.dash || "solid" };
      item.opacity = spec.opacity ?? 1;
      if (spec.marker) item.marker = {
        symbol: spec.marker, size: points.map((point, i) => i % (spec.markerEvery || 1) === 0 ? 4 : 0),
        color: "#111", line: { width: .8, color: "#111" }
      };
    }
    return item;
  });
  data.push(...governments.map(government => ({
    type: "scatter", mode: "markers", x: [null], y: [null], name: government[0],
    showlegend: !placement.external, hoverinfo: "skip", legend: "legend",
    marker: { symbol: "square", size: 10, color: rgba(government[3], .3), line: { color: "#000", width: 1 } }
  })));
  const annotations = [];
  if (plot.id === "fig2c") annotations.push(
    { xref: "paper", yref: "y", x: .02, y: 0, yshift: 12, text: "Deficit", showarrow: false, font: { size: 12 } },
    { xref: "paper", yref: "y", x: .02, y: 0, yshift: -12, text: "Surplus", showarrow: false, font: { size: 12 } }
  );
  const layout = {
    font: { family: '"Times New Roman", Times, serif', size: narrow ? 11 : 12, color: "#222" },
    separators: ".,", paper_bgcolor: "#fff", plot_bgcolor: "#fff", barmode: "group",
    // Visible page titles are static HTML headings; PNG exports retain theirs.
    title: { text: options.forExport ? wrappedTitle(plot.title, width, narrow ? 12 : 14) +
      (plot.subtitle ? `<br><span style="font-size:11px">${wrappedTitle(resolvePriceBaseText(plot.subtitle, plot, series), width, 11)}</span>` : "") : "",
      x: margins.l / width, xanchor: "left", font: { size: narrow ? 12 : 14 } },
    height, margin: margins,
    xaxis: { type: "date", range: [plot.start, end], tickmode: "array",
      ...generateYearTicks(plot.start, end, finalDate, width, margins, plot.show_first_year === true, plot.required_tick_year, plot.tick_month ?? 1), tickformat: "%Y", tickangle: -90,
      showgrid: true, gridcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.13)", griddash: "dot", fixedrange: true, zeroline: false },
    yaxis: { title: { text: plot.axis.title, standoff: 7 }, range,
      showgrid: true, gridcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,.13)", griddash: "dot", fixedrange: true,
      zeroline: true, zerolinecolor: "#888", zerolinewidth: .8 },
    legend: { title: { text: "Presidents", font: { size: legendTitleFont } },
      ...(placement.position || { x: .02, y: .98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top" }),
      font: { size: legendFont }, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,.94)",
      bordercolor: "#000", borderwidth: 1, itemclick: false, itemdoubleclick: false },
    shapes, annotations, showlegend: !placement.external, hovermode: "closest", dragmode: false
  };
  if (plot.axis2) layout.yaxis2 = {
    title: { text: plot.axis2.title, standoff: 7 }, range: ranges.y2,
    overlaying: "y", side: "right", showgrid: false, fixedrange: true, zeroline: false
  };
  if (plot.axis2 && Number.isFinite(plot.axis2.tickStep)) {
    layout.yaxis2.tick0 = Number.isFinite(plot.align_index_base) ? plot.align_index_base : 0;
    layout.yaxis2.dtick = plot.axis2.tickStep;
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(plot.axis.tickStep)) {
    layout.yaxis.tick0 = Number.isFinite(plot.axis.min) ? plot.axis.min : 0;
    layout.yaxis.dtick = plot.axis.tickStep;
  }
  return { data, layout, config: { locale: "en", responsive: true, displayModeBar: false,
    displaylogo: false, scrollZoom: false, doubleClick: false },
    legendInfo: { inside, external: !inside && placement.external && !fixedLegend, overlay: fixedLegend,
      position: plot.president_legend?.position, columns: twoColumns ? 2 : 1,
      width, height, margins, fontSize: legendFont, titleSize: legendTitleFont,
      items: governments.map(government => ({ name: government[0], color: government[3] })) } };
}

// External public API helpers; the host dashboard owns raw data, storage and refresh scheduling.
/** Public MTE Power BI response decoder. No requests or third-party imports. */
function decodePowerBIResponse(payload) {
  const data = payload?.results?.[0]?.result?.data;
  const dsr = data?.dsr;
  if (!dsr || dsr.DataShapes || !Array.isArray(dsr.DS)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid Power BI response or semantic query error');
  }
  const selections = data.descriptor?.Select || [];
  const records = [];
  for (const ds of dsr.DS) {
    if (ds.RT?.length) throw new Error('Truncated Power BI result: restart tokens present');
    const dictionaries = ds.ValueDicts || {};
    let schema = null;
    let previous = null;
    for (const phase of ds.PH || []) {
      for (const compressedRows of Object.values(phase)) {
        if (!Array.isArray(compressedRows)) continue;
        for (const compressed of compressedRows) {
          if (compressed.S) schema = compressed.S;
          if (!schema) throw new Error('Missing Power BI column schema');
          let cursor = 0;
          const row = schema.map((column, index) => {
            const bit = 2 ** index;
            if ((compressed.R || 0) & bit) {
              if (!previous) throw new Error('Repeat before first Power BI row');
              return previous[index];
            }
            if ((compressed['Ø'] || 0) & bit) return null;
            let value;
            if (Array.isArray(compressed.C)) {
              if (cursor >= compressed.C.length) throw new Error('Incomplete Power BI row');
              value = compressed.C[cursor++];
            } else value = compressed[column.N] ?? null;
            if (column.DN !== undefined && Number.isInteger(value)) {
              const dictionary = dictionaries[column.DN];
              if (!dictionary || value < 0 || value >= dictionary.length) {
                throw new Error('Invalid Power BI dictionary reference');
              }
              value = dictionary[value];
            }
            return value;
          });
          if (compressed.C && cursor !== compressed.C.length) throw new Error('Extra Power BI row values');
          const record = {};
          schema.forEach((column, index) => {
            const selected = selections.find(item => item.Value === column.N);
            record[selected?.Name || column.N] = row[index];
          });
          records.push(record);
          previous = row;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return records;
}

const RAIS_GROUP_CODES = Object.freeze({
  'Fundamental incompleto': 'rais:less_than_fundamental',
  'Fundamental completo': 'rais:fundamental_complete',
  'Médio completo': 'rais:secondary_complete',
  'Superior completo ou mais': 'rais:tertiary_complete',
  'Total': 'rais:total'
});

/** Returns five raw-count series. Plot groupCount / totalCount * 100. */
function parseRAISSchooling(payload) {
  const byYear = new Map();
  for (const record of decodePowerBIResponse(payload)) {
    if (record.variaveis && record.variaveis !== 'abs_rais_emp_formal') continue;
    const year = record.period;
    const group = record['abertura.1'];
    const count = record.valor;
    if (!Number.isInteger(year) || year < 1900 || year > 2200 ||
        !Object.hasOwn(RAIS_GROUP_CODES, group) ||
        !Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid RAIS employment observation');
    }
    if (record['tipo_abertura.2'] != null || record['abertura.2'] != null) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected second RAIS breakdown');
    }
    const groups = byYear.get(year) || new Map();
    if (groups.has(group)) throw new Error('Duplicate RAIS employment observation');
    groups.set(group, count);
    byYear.set(year, groups);
  }
  if (!byYear.size) throw new Error('Empty RAIS employment series');
  const series = Object.fromEntries(Object.values(RAIS_GROUP_CODES).map(code => [code, []]));
  for (const [year, groups] of [...byYear].sort(([a], [b]) => a - b)) {
    if (groups.size !== 5 || groups.get('Total') <= 0) throw new Error('Incomplete RAIS schooling groups');
    const sum = [...groups].filter(([group]) => group !== 'Total').reduce((a, [, count]) => a + count, 0);
    if (sum !== groups.get('Total')) throw new Error('RAIS schooling groups do not sum to total');
    for (const [group, count] of groups) series[RAIS_GROUP_CODES[group]].push([`${year}-12-01`, count]);
  }
  return series;
}

const publicProviderOrigins = Object.freeze({
  worldbank:"https://api.worldbank.org", unesco:"https://api.uis.unesco.org",
  sidra:"https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br", unicef:"https://sdmx.data.unicef.org",
  mte_powerbi:"https://wabi-brazil-south-d-primary-api.analysis.windows.net"
});
function isPublicCode(code){
  return typeof code==="string"&&!code.startsWith("ipea:")&&
    Object.hasOwn(PUBLIC_API_SOURCES,code)&&
    Object.hasOwn(publicProviderOrigins,PUBLIC_API_SOURCES[code]?.provider);
}
function finitePoint(year,value){
  if(!/^\d{4}$/.test(String(year))||(typeof value!=="number"&&typeof value!=="string")||!String(value).trim())return null;
  const number=Number(String(value).replace(",",".")),date=`${year}-01-01`;
  return Number.isFinite(number)&&date>="1995-01-01"&&date<=observationMonthLimit()?[date,number]:null;
}
function parsePublicPayload(payload,code){
  if(!isPublicCode(code))throw Error("Unknown external API series.");
  const source=PUBLIC_API_SOURCES[code];
  let points=[];
  if(source.provider==="worldbank"){
    if(!Array.isArray(payload)||!Array.isArray(payload[1])||Number(payload[0]?.pages)!==1)throw Error("Invalid or incomplete World Bank response.");
    for(const row of payload[1]){
      if(row.countryiso3code!=="BRA"||row.indicator?.id!==source.indicator)continue;
      const p=finitePoint(row.date,row.value);if(p)points.push(p);
    }
  }else if(source.provider==="unesco"){
    if(!Array.isArray(payload?.records))throw Error("Invalid UNESCO response.");
    for(const row of payload.records){
      if(row.geoUnit!=="BRA"||row.indicatorId!==source.indicator)continue;
      if(row.magnitude!=null&&row.magnitude!==""&&Number(row.magnitude)!==0)throw Error("Unexpected UNESCO magnitude.");
      const p=finitePoint(row.year,row.value);if(p)points.push(p);
    }
  }else if(source.provider==="mte_powerbi"){
    if(source.parser && source.parser!=="rais_schooling")throw Error("Unsupported MTE parser.");
    points=parseRAISSchooling(payload)[code]||[];
  }else if(source.provider==="sidra"){
    if(!Array.isArray(payload))throw Error("Invalid IBGE response.");
    for(const variable of payload){
      if(String(variable.id)!==source.indicator)continue;
      for(const result of variable.resultados||[]){
        const matches=Object.entries(source.classifications).every(([id,category])=>{
          const dimension=(result.classificacoes||[]).find(c=>String(c.id)===id);
          return dimension&&Object.hasOwn(dimension.categoria||{},category);
        });
        if(!matches)continue;
        for(const series of result.series||[]){
          if(String(series.localidade?.id)!=="1"||series.localidade?.nivel?.id!=="N1")continue;
          for(const [year,value] of Object.entries(series.serie||{})){const p=finitePoint(year,value);if(p)points.push(p);}
        }
      }
    }
  }else if(source.provider==="unicef"){
    const data=payload?.data||payload,structure=data?.structure;
    if(!structure?.dimensions||!Array.isArray(data.dataSets))throw Error("Invalid UNICEF SDMX response.");
    const dims=structure.dimensions.series,time=structure.dimensions.observation;
    if(!Array.isArray(dims)||!Array.isArray(time)||!time.some(d=>d.id==="TIME_PERIOD"))throw Error("Invalid UNICEF dimensions.");
    for(const set of data.dataSets)for(const [key,series] of Object.entries(set.series||{})){
      const indices=key.split(":").map(Number),selected=Object.fromEntries(dims.map((d,i)=>[d.id,d.values[indices[i]]?.id]));
      if(selected.REF_AREA!=="BRA"||selected.INDICATOR!==source.indicator||selected.AGE!==source.age)continue;
      for(const [key,values] of Object.entries(series.observations||{})){
        const indices=key.split(":").map(Number);const dim=time.findIndex(d=>d.id==="TIME_PERIOD");
        const year=time[dim]?.values[indices[dim]]?.id,p=finitePoint(year,values[0]);if(p)points.push(p);
      }
    }
  }else throw Error("Unsupported API.");
  const unique=new Map();for(const [d,v] of points){
    if(!/^\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-01$/.test(d)||!Number.isFinite(v))throw Error("Invalid annual API observation.");
    if(d<"1995-01-01"||d>observationMonthLimit())continue;
    if(unique.has(d)&&unique.get(d)!==v)throw Error("Conflicting values.");unique.set(d,v);
  }
  return [...unique].sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
}
// Identical multi-series responses share requests; different POST reports and
// query bodies never share a cache entry. Failures remain retryable this cycle.
const publicPayloads=new Map(),publicModelPromises=new Map();
function trustedPublicURL(value,provider){
  const url=new URL(value);
  if(url.protocol!=="https:"||url.origin!==publicProviderOrigins[provider]||url.username||url.password)throw Error("Untrusted API endpoint.");
  return url;
}
function publicRequestKey(cycle,url,method,headers,body){
  const normalized=Object.entries(headers||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k.toLowerCase(),String(v)]).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b));
  return JSON.stringify([cycle,url.href,method,normalized,body??null]);
}
async function publicModelMetadata(source,signal,fetcher,cycle){
  const discovery=source.discovery;
  if(!discovery?.url)throw Error("Missing MTE model discovery URL.");
  const url=trustedPublicURL(discovery.url,"mte_powerbi");
  const key=publicRequestKey(cycle,url,"GET",discovery.headers,null);
  if(!publicModelPromises.has(key)){
    const pending=(async()=>{
      const response=await fetcher(url,{signal,credentials:"omit",cache:"no-store",headers:discovery.headers});
      if(!response.ok)throw Error("Unable to refresh MTE model metadata.");
      const meta=await response.json(),model=meta.models?.[0],reportId=meta.exploration?.reportId;
      if(!Number.isInteger(model?.id)||typeof model.dbName!=="string"||!model.dbName||!Number.isInteger(reportId))throw Error("Invalid MTE model metadata.");
      return {modelId:model.id,datasetId:model.dbName,reportId};
    })();
    publicModelPromises.set(key,pending);
    void pending.catch(()=>{if(publicModelPromises.get(key)===pending)publicModelPromises.delete(key);});
  }
  return publicModelPromises.get(key);
}
async function fetchPublicSeries(code,signal,fetcher=fetch){
  if(!isPublicCode(code))throw Error("Unknown external API series.");
  const source=PUBLIC_API_SOURCES[code],url=trustedPublicURL(source.url,source.provider);
  const method=source.method||"GET",cycle=monthlyUpdateCycle();
  if(method!=="GET"&&method!=="POST")throw Error("Unsupported public API method.");
  if(source.provider==="worldbank")url.searchParams.set("date",`1995:${observationMonthLimit().slice(0,4)}`);
  // Distinct public reports and POST queries share this URL. Their bodies and
  // resource keys must remain separate while identical series share a request.
  const key=publicRequestKey(cycle,url,method,source.headers,source.body);
  if(!publicPayloads.has(key)){
    const pending=(async()=>{
      const options={signal,credentials:"omit",cache:"no-store"};
      if(source.headers)options.headers={...source.headers};
      if(method==="POST"){
        options.method="POST";
        const body=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source.body));
        if(source.provider==="mte_powerbi"){
          // Validate the configured discovery endpoint even when its network
          // request fails; an untrusted configuration must not use fallback.
          trustedPublicURL(source.discovery?.url,"mte_powerbi");
          try{
            const model=await publicModelMetadata(source,signal,fetcher,cycle);
            body.modelId=model.modelId;
            for(const query of body.queries){
              query.ApplicationContext.DatasetId=model.datasetId;
              for(const report of query.ApplicationContext.Sources)report.ReportId=model.reportId;
            }
          }catch(error){/* The last verified public model remains an available fallback. */}
        }
        options.body=JSON.stringify(body);
      }
      const response=await fetcher(url,options);if(!response.ok)throw Error("API request failed.");
      return response.json();
    })();
    publicPayloads.set(key,pending);
    void pending.catch(()=>{if(publicPayloads.get(key)===pending)publicPayloads.delete(key);});
  }
  const pending=publicPayloads.get(key);
  try{
    const points=parsePublicPayload(await pending,code);
    const required=`${source.minimum_year}-01-01`;
    if(!Number.isInteger(source.minimum_year)||!points.length||points.at(-1)[0]<required)throw Error("API response does not retain verified reference-year coverage.");
    return points;
  }catch(error){
    if(publicPayloads.get(key)===pending)publicPayloads.delete(key);
    throw error;
  }
}


let libraryPromise;
function loadPlotly() {
  if (window.Plotly) return Promise.resolve(window.Plotly);
  if (!libraryPromise) libraryPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-basic-3.1.0.min.js";
    script.onload = () => resolve(window.Plotly);
    script.onerror = error => { libraryPromise = undefined; reject(error); };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
  return libraryPromise;
}

function monthlyUpdateCycle(now = new Date()) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone: "America/Fortaleza", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit"
  }).formatToParts(now).filter(part => part.type !== "literal").map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  let year = Number(parts.year), month = Number(parts.month);
  if (Number(parts.day) < 20) {
    month--;
    if (!month) { month = 12; year--; }
  }
  return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, "0")}-20`;
}

function observationMonthLimit(now = new Date()) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
    timeZone: "America/Fortaleza", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit"
  }).formatToParts(now).filter(part => part.type !== "literal").map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-01`;
}

const currentRaw = { ...SEEDS };
const refreshedCycles = new Map();
const sourceVersions = new Map(Object.entries(MANIFEST.ipeadata_versions || {})
  .map(([code, version]) => [isIpeaCode(code) ? code : `ipea:${code}`, version])
  .filter(([code, version]) => isIpeaCode(code) && typeof version === "string" && version.length));
const CACHE_PREFIX = "brazil-economy-monthly-sgs-";
const IPEA_CACHE_PREFIX = "brazil-economy-monthly-ipeadata-";
function cacheKey(code) {
  if (isPublicCode(code)) return `brazil-economy-monthly-public-v1-${code}`;
  return isIpeaCode(code) ? `${IPEA_CACHE_PREFIX}${code.slice(5)}` : `${CACHE_PREFIX}${code}`;
}

function cachedSeries(code) {
  // A successful in-memory refresh wins even if browser storage could not be written.
  if (refreshedCycles.get(code) === monthlyUpdateCycle()) return currentRaw[code];
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(cacheKey(code)));
    if (saved && saved.retrieved >= (isPublicCode(code) ? PUBLIC_SNAPSHOT_DATE : SNAPSHOT_DATE) && Array.isArray(saved.values) && saved.values.length) {
      const valid = saved.values.every(point => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-01$/.test(point[0]) && Number.isFinite(point[1]));
      const values = valid ? saved.values.filter(point => point[0] <= observationMonthLimit()) : [];
      const seed = SEEDS[code] || [];
      const coverage = values.length && (!seed.length || (values.length >= seed.length &&
        values[0][0] <= seed[0][0] && values.at(-1)[0] >= seed.at(-1)[0]));
      if (valid && coverage) {
        currentRaw[code] = values;
        if (isIpeaCode(code)) {
          if (typeof saved.sourceUpdated === "string" && saved.sourceUpdated) sourceVersions.set(code, saved.sourceUpdated);
          else sourceVersions.delete(code);
        }
        if (saved.updateCycle === monthlyUpdateCycle()) refreshedCycles.set(code, saved.updateCycle);
      }
    }
  } catch (error) { /* Browser storage is optional. */ }
  return currentRaw[code];
}

function parseIpeaRows(rows, code) {
  if (!isIpeaCode(code) || !Array.isArray(rows)) return [];
  const seriesCode = code.slice(5);
  const regional = isRegionalIpeaSeries(seriesCode);
  return rows.flatMap(row => {
    if (!row || row.SERCODIGO !== seriesCode) return [];
    const level = row.NIVNOME ?? "", territory = String(row.TERCODIGO ?? "");
    const national = level === "Brasil" && territory === "0";
    if (regional ? !national : !(national || (level === "" && territory === ""))) return [];
    const match = /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-([0-2]\d|3[01])(?:T|$)/.exec(row.VALDATA || "");
    if (!match || match[3] === "00") return [];
    const date = `${match[1]}-${match[2]}-${match[3]}`;
    const actualDate = new Date(date + "T12:00:00Z");
    if (!Number.isFinite(actualDate.getTime()) || actualDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== date) return [];
    const originalValue = row.VALVALOR;
    if ((typeof originalValue !== "number" && typeof originalValue !== "string") ||
        !String(originalValue).trim()) return [];
    const value = Number(originalValue);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? [[`${match[1]}-${match[2]}-01`, value]] : [];
  });
}

async function fetchIpeaSeries(code, signal, fetcher = fetch) {
  if (!isIpeaCode(code)) throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata series code.");
  const seriesCode = code.slice(5);
  const origin = "https://www.ipeadata.gov.br";
  let url = new URL(`/api/odata4/Metadados('${seriesCode}')/Valores`, origin);
  if (isRegionalIpeaSeries(seriesCode)) {
    url.searchParams.set("$filter", "NIVNOME eq 'Brasil' and TERCODIGO eq '0'");
  }
  const visited = new Set(), monthly = new Map();
  for (let page = 0; page < 100; page++) {
    // OData may return an absolute HTTP continuation for this HTTPS service.
    if (url.hostname === "www.ipeadata.gov.br" && url.protocol === "http:") url.protocol = "https:";
    if (url.origin !== origin || !url.pathname.startsWith("/api/odata4/") ||
        url.username || url.password || visited.has(url.href)) throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata continuation URL.");
    visited.add(url.href);
    const response = await fetcher(url, { signal, cache: "no-store" });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Ipeadata request failed (${response.status}).`);
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.value)) throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata response.");
    for (const point of parseIpeaRows(payload.value, code)) monthly.set(...point);
    const next = payload["@odata.nextLink"];
    if (!next) return [...monthly].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    if (typeof next !== "string") throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata continuation URL.");
    url = new URL(next, url);
  }
  throw new Error("Too many Ipeadata continuation pages.");
}

async function fetchIpeaVersion(code, signal, fetcher = fetch) {
  if (!isIpeaCode(code)) throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata series code.");
  const seriesCode = code.slice(5);
  const url = new URL(`https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados('${seriesCode}')`);
  const response = await fetcher(url, { signal, cache: "no-store" });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Ipeadata metadata request failed (${response.status}).`);
  const payload = await response.json();
  const metadata = Array.isArray(payload?.value) ? payload.value.find(row => row.SERCODIGO === seriesCode) : payload;
  if (metadata?.SERCODIGO !== seriesCode || typeof metadata.SERATUALIZACAO !== "string" ||
      !metadata.SERATUALIZACAO) throw new Error("Invalid Ipeadata source version.");
  return metadata.SERATUALIZACAO;
}

const requestQueue = [];
const requestPromises = new Map();
let activeRequests = 0;
function runRequests() {
  while (activeRequests < 2 && requestQueue.length) {
    const task = requestQueue.shift();
    activeRequests++;
    task.run().then(task.resolve, () => task.resolve(null)).finally(() => { activeRequests--; runRequests(); });
  }
}

function freshSeries(code) {
  cachedSeries(code);
  const updateCycle = monthlyUpdateCycle();
  if (refreshedCycles.get(code) === updateCycle) return Promise.resolve(currentRaw[code]);
  const requestKey = `${code}:${updateCycle}`;
  if (!requestPromises.has(requestKey)) requestPromises.set(requestKey, new Promise(resolve => {
    requestQueue.push({ resolve, run: async () => {
      if (isPublicCode(code)) {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30000);
        try {
          const parsed = await fetchPublicSeries(code, controller.signal);
          const values = parsed.filter(point => point[0] >= "1995-01-01" && point[0] <= observationMonthLimit());
          const previous = currentRaw[code] || [];
          if (!values.length || (previous.length && (values.length < previous.length ||
              values[0][0] > previous[0][0] || values.at(-1)[0] < previous.at(-1)[0]))) return null;
          currentRaw[code] = values;
          refreshedCycles.set(code, updateCycle);
          try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey(code), JSON.stringify({ retrieved: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), updateCycle, values })); }
          catch (error) { /* Browser storage is optional. */ }
          return values;
        } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
      }
      if (isIpeaCode(code)) {
        let sourceUpdated;
        if (code === "ipea:FAM_PBF") {
          // The service ignores territorial query filters and returns all municipalities.
          // Check its small metadata record first to avoid a large unchanged annual download.
          const metadataController = new AbortController();
          const metadataTimer = setTimeout(() => metadataController.abort(), 15000);
          try { sourceUpdated = await fetchIpeaVersion(code, metadataController.signal); }
          catch (error) { /* Metadata is an optimization; the values request remains available. */ }
          finally { clearTimeout(metadataTimer); }
          const existing = currentRaw[code];
          if (sourceUpdated && sourceVersions.get(code) === sourceUpdated && Array.isArray(existing) && existing.length) {
            refreshedCycles.set(code, updateCycle);
            try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey(code), JSON.stringify({ retrieved: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), updateCycle,
              sourceUpdated, values: existing })); } catch (error) { /* Browser storage is optional. */ }
            return existing;
          }
        }
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 45000);
        try {
          const parsed = await fetchIpeaSeries(code, controller.signal);
          const values = parsed.filter(point => point[0] >= "1995-01-01" && point[0] <= observationMonthLimit());
          const previous = currentRaw[code] || [];
          if (!values.length || (previous.length && (values.length < previous.length ||
              values[0][0] > previous[0][0] || values.at(-1)[0] < previous.at(-1)[0]))) return null;
          currentRaw[code] = values;
          if (code === "ipea:FAM_PBF") {
            if (sourceUpdated) sourceVersions.set(code, sourceUpdated);
            else sourceVersions.delete(code);
          }
          refreshedCycles.set(code, updateCycle);
          try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey(code), JSON.stringify({ retrieved: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), updateCycle,
            sourceUpdated: sourceVersions.get(code), values })); }
          catch (error) { /* Browser storage is optional. */ }
          return values;
        } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
      }
      const url = new URL(`https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.${code}/dados`);
      url.searchParams.set("formato", "json");
      if (code === 1178) {
        const latest = currentRaw[code]?.at(-1)?.[0] || "1999-01-01";
        const now = new Date();
        const start = latest > `${now.getFullYear() - 9}-01-01` ? latest : `${now.getFullYear() - 9}-01-01`;
        url.searchParams.set("dataInicial", `${start.slice(8, 10)}/${start.slice(5, 7)}/${start.slice(0, 4)}`);
        url.searchParams.set("dataFinal", `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${now.getFullYear()}`);
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
        if (!response.ok) return null;
        const rows = await response.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return null;
        const parsed = rows.flatMap(row => {
          const match = /^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(row.data || "");
          if (!match || !String(row.valor ?? "").trim()) return [];
          const value = Number(String(row.valor).replace(",", "."));
          return Number.isFinite(value) ? [[`${match[3]}-${match[2]}-${match[1]}`, value]] : [];
        }).sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
        const monthly = new Map();
        for (const point of parsed) {
          const date = point[0].slice(0, 7) + "-01";
          if (code !== 1178 || !monthly.has(date)) monthly.set(date, point[1]);
        }
        if (!monthly.size) return null;
        const merged = code === 1178 ? new Map(currentRaw[code] || []) : new Map();
        for (const point of monthly) merged.set(...point);
        const historyStart = code === 433 || code === 1619 ? "1996-01-01" : "1999-01-01";
        const values = [...merged].filter(point => point[0] >= historyStart && point[0] <= observationMonthLimit())
          .sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
        if (!values.length) return null;
        const previous = currentRaw[code] || [];
        if (code !== 1178 && previous.length && (values.length < previous.length || values[0][0] > previous[0][0] ||
            values.at(-1)[0] < previous.at(-1)[0])) return null;
        currentRaw[code] = values;
        refreshedCycles.set(code, updateCycle);
        try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey(code), JSON.stringify({ retrieved: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), updateCycle, values })); }
        catch (error) { /* A full or disabled cache does not affect the chart. */ }
        return values;
      } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
    } });
    runRequests();
  }));
  const pending = requestPromises.get(requestKey);
  // A failed request must remain retryable during the same update cycle.
  return pending.then(values => {
    if (!values && requestPromises.get(requestKey) === pending) requestPromises.delete(requestKey);
    return values;
  });
}

function fillSidebar(plot, series) {
  const latest = document.getElementById(`latest-${plot.id}`);
  latest.replaceChildren();
  for (const trace of series) {
    const row = document.createElement("p");
    row.textContent = `${trace.spec.label}: ${dateLabel(trace.points.at(-1)[0], trace.spec.frequency)}`;
    latest.appendChild(row);
  }
  const keys = document.getElementById(`keys-${plot.id}`);
  if (!keys || keys.childElementCount) return;
  for (const trace of series) {
    const row = document.createElement("span");
    row.className = "macro-key";
    const sample = document.createElement("span");
    sample.className = "macro-key-sample";
    const spec = trace.spec;
    const color = spec.color || "#111";
    sample.style.opacity = spec.opacity ?? 1;
    sample.style.border = "none";
    if (spec.type === "bar") { sample.style.height = "8px"; sample.style.background = color; }
    else {
      sample.style.height = `${spec.legendWidth ?? 2}px`;
      const patterns = {
        solid: color,
        dash: `repeating-linear-gradient(to right,${color} 0 7px,transparent 7px 11px)`,
        dot: `repeating-linear-gradient(to right,${color} 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px)`,
        dashdot: `repeating-linear-gradient(to right,${color} 0 7px,transparent 7px 10px,${color} 10px 12px,transparent 12px 16px)`
      };
      sample.style.background = patterns[spec.dash || "solid"];
      if (spec.marker) {
        sample.style.position = "relative";
        const cross = document.createElement("span");
        cross.textContent = "×";
        cross.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:9px;top:-8px;font:14px/1 serif;color:#111";
        sample.appendChild(cross);
      }
    }
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "macro-key-label";
    label.textContent = spec.legendLabel || spec.label;
    row.append(sample, label);
    keys.appendChild(row);
  }
}

function fillPresidents(plot, info) {
  const box = document.getElementById(`presidents-${plot.id}`);
  const items = document.getElementById(`president-items-${plot.id}`);
  box.hidden = !(info.external || info.overlay);
  box.classList.toggle("is-overlay", !!info.overlay);
  box.classList.toggle("has-two-columns", info.columns === 2);
  items.classList.toggle("is-two-column", info.columns === 2);
  box.style.left = box.style.top = box.style.transform = "";
  items.style.gridTemplateRows = "";
  if (box.hidden) return;
  if (info.columns === 2) items.style.gridTemplateRows = `repeat(${Math.ceil(info.items.length / 2)}, auto)`;
  if (info.overlay) {
    const horizontal = info.position.split("-")[1];
    const vertical = info.position.split("-")[0];
    const bottom = vertical === "bottom";
    const middle = vertical === "middle";
    const plotWidth = info.width - info.margins.l - info.margins.r;
    const plotHeight = info.height - info.margins.t - info.margins.b;
    const inset = 5;
    const insetX = Math.max(inset, (plot.president_legend?.inset_x ?? 0) * plotWidth);
    const x = horizontal === "left" ? info.margins.l + insetX :
      horizontal === "center" ? info.margins.l + plotWidth / 2 : info.width - info.margins.r - inset;
    const y = bottom ? info.height - info.margins.b - inset : middle ? info.margins.t + plotHeight / 2 : info.margins.t + inset;
    box.style.left = `${x}px`;
    box.style.top = `${y}px`;
    box.style.transform = `translate(${horizontal === "left" ? "0" : horizontal === "center" ? "-50%" : "-100%"},${bottom ? "-100%" : middle ? "-50%" : "0"})`;
  }
  box.style.fontSize = `${info.fontSize}px`;
  box.style.setProperty("--macro-margin-left", `${info.margins.l}px`);
  box.style.setProperty("--macro-margin-right", `${info.margins.r}px`);
  box.querySelector(".macro-presidents-title").style.fontSize = `${info.titleSize}px`;
  items.replaceChildren();
  for (const government of info.items) {
    const item = document.createElement("span");
    item.className = "macro-president-item";
    const swatch = document.createElement("span");
    swatch.className = "macro-president-swatch";
    swatch.style.backgroundColor = rgba(government.color, .3);
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.textContent = government.name;
    item.append(swatch, label);
    items.appendChild(item);
  }
}

function fillInsideBoxes(plot, info) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(`chart-${plot.id}`).parentElement;
  const place = (box, dimensions, title, items) => {
    box.hidden = false;
    const plotWidth = info.width - info.margins.l - info.margins.r;
    const plotHeight = info.height - info.margins.t - info.margins.b;
    const left = info.margins.l + dimensions.position.x * plotWidth;
    const top = info.margins.t + (1 - dimensions.position.y) * plotHeight;
    Object.assign(box.style, { position: "absolute", left: `${left}px`, top: `${top}px`,
      width: `${dimensions.box.width}px`, height: `${dimensions.box.height}px`, maxWidth: "none",
      transform: "none", margin: "0", padding: "4px", fontSize: `${dimensions.fontSize}px` });
    Object.assign(title.style, { margin: "0 0 3px", fontSize: `${dimensions.titleSize}px`,
      lineHeight: `${dimensions.titleSize}px`, fontWeight: "400" });
    Object.assign(items.style, { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${dimensions.columns}, ${dimensions.columnWidth}px)`,
      gridTemplateRows: `repeat(${dimensions.rows}, ${dimensions.rowHeight}px)`,
      gridAutoFlow: "column", gap: `0 ${dimensions.columnGap ?? 10}px`, margin: "0", padding: "0", border: "0" });
  };
  const presidents = document.getElementById(`presidents-${plot.id}`);
  const presidentItems = document.getElementById(`president-items-${plot.id}`);
  presidents.classList.add("is-overlay");
  presidents.classList.remove("has-two-columns");
  presidentItems.classList.remove("is-two-column");
  presidentItems.replaceChildren();
  const dimensions = info.inside.presidents;
  for (const government of info.items) {
    const row = document.createElement("span");
    row.className = "macro-president-item";
    row.style.fontSize = `${dimensions.fontSize}px`;
    row.style.lineHeight = `${dimensions.rowHeight}px`;
    row.style.gap = "4px";
    const swatch = document.createElement("span");
    swatch.className = "macro-president-swatch";
    swatch.style.cssText = `width:10px;height:10px;flex:0 0 10px;background:${rgba(government.color, .3)}`;
    const name = document.createElement("span");
    name.textContent = government.name;
    row.append(swatch, name);
    presidentItems.appendChild(row);
  }
  place(presidents, dimensions, presidents.querySelector(".macro-presidents-title"), presidentItems);
  const keys = document.getElementById(`keys-${plot.id}`);
  if (keys && info.inside.indicators) {
    const indicatorBox = keys.parentElement;
    indicatorBox.classList.add("macro-inset-indicators");
    if (indicatorBox.parentElement !== canvas) canvas.appendChild(indicatorBox);
    place(indicatorBox, info.inside.indicators, indicatorBox.querySelector(".macro-key-title"), keys);
    for (const [index, key] of [...keys.children].entries()) {
      key.querySelector(".macro-key-label").textContent = info.inside.indicatorLabels?.[index] ||
        plot.traces[index].legendLabel || plot.traces[index].label;
      key.style.fontSize = `${info.inside.indicators.fontSize}px`;
      key.style.lineHeight = `${info.inside.indicators.rowHeight}px`;
      key.querySelector(".macro-key-sample").style.cssText += ";width:24px;flex:0 0 24px;margin:0";
      key.querySelector(".macro-key-label").style.fontSize = `${info.inside.indicators.fontSize}px`;
    }
  }
}

function drawInsideExportLegends(figure, series) {
  const { layout, legendInfo } = figure;
  const pw = layout.width - layout.margin.l - layout.margin.r;
  const ph = layout.height - layout.margin.t - layout.margin.b;
  const line = (x1, y1, x2, y2, options = {}) => ({ type: "line", xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
    x0: x1 / pw, x1: x2 / pw, y0: 1 - y1 / ph, y1: 1 - y2 / ph,
    line: { color: "#111", width: 1.5, ...options }, layer: "above" });
  const rectangle = (x, y, w, h, fill) => ({ type: "rect", xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
    x0: x / pw, x1: (x + w) / pw, y0: 1 - (y + h) / ph, y1: 1 - y / ph,
    fillcolor: fill, line: { color: "#000", width: 1 }, layer: "above" });
  const label = (text, x, y, size) => ({ xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: x / pw, y: 1 - y / ph,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false, text,
    font: { family: '"Times New Roman", Times, serif', size, color: "#222" } });
  const draw = (dimensions, title, values, presidents) => {
    if (!dimensions) return;
    const left = dimensions.position.x * pw;
    const top = (1 - dimensions.position.y) * ph;
    layout.shapes.push(rectangle(left, top, dimensions.box.width, dimensions.box.height, "rgba(255,255,255,.96)"));
    layout.annotations.push(label(title, left + 4, top + 3, dimensions.titleSize));
    values.forEach((value, index) => {
      const col = Math.floor(index / dimensions.rows), row = index % dimensions.rows;
      const x = left + 5 + col * (dimensions.columnWidth + (dimensions.columnGap ?? 10));
      const y = top + 5 + dimensions.titleSize + 3 + row * dimensions.rowHeight;
      if (presidents) {
        layout.shapes.push(rectangle(x, y + (dimensions.rowHeight - 10) / 2, 10, 10, rgba(value.color, .3)));
        layout.annotations.push(label(value.name, x + 14, y + 1, dimensions.fontSize));
      } else {
        const spec = value.spec;
        if (spec.type === "bar") {
          layout.shapes.push(rectangle(x, y + (dimensions.rowHeight - 7) / 2, 24, 7, rgba(spec.color || "#111", spec.opacity ?? 1)));
        } else {
          const sample = line(x, y + dimensions.rowHeight / 2, x + 24, y + dimensions.rowHeight / 2,
            { color: rgba(spec.color || "#111", spec.opacity ?? 1), dash: spec.dash || "solid", width: spec.legendWidth ?? 1.5 });
          layout.shapes.push(sample);
          if (spec.marker) layout.annotations.push(label("×", x + 8, y - 1, dimensions.fontSize + 4));
        }
        layout.annotations.push(label(spec.legendLabel || spec.label, x + 32, y + 1, dimensions.fontSize));
      }
    });
  };
  draw(legendInfo.inside.presidents, "Presidents", legendInfo.items, true);
  draw(legendInfo.inside.indicators, "Indicators", series, false);
}

// PNGs reproduce the requested two-column boxes in plot coordinates.
function fixedExportLegend(plot, figure, series) {
  if (figure.legendInfo.inside) { drawInsideExportLegends(figure, series); return; }
  if (plot.president_legend?.columns !== 2) return;
  const { layout, legendInfo } = figure;
  const pw = layout.width - layout.margin.l - layout.margin.r;
  const ph = layout.height - layout.margin.t - layout.margin.b;
  const rows = Math.ceil(legendInfo.items.length / 2);
  const padding = 6, column = 66, row = 15, title = 15;
  const bw = column * 2 + padding * 2, bh = padding * 2 + title + row * rows;
  const horizontal = plot.president_legend.position.split("-")[1];
  const external = plot.president_legend.position === "external";
  const left = external ? 0 : horizontal === "left" ? Math.max(5, (plot.president_legend?.inset_x ?? 0) * pw) : horizontal === "center" ? (pw - bw) / 2 : pw - bw - 5;
  const top = external ? ph + 52 : plot.president_legend.position.startsWith("bottom-") ? ph - bh - 5 :
    plot.president_legend.position.startsWith("middle-") ? (ph - bh) / 2 : 5;
  const rect = (x, y, w, h, color, border = "#000") => ({
    type: "rect", xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x0: x / pw, x1: (x + w) / pw,
    y0: 1 - (y + h) / ph, y1: 1 - y / ph, fillcolor: color,
    line: { color: border, width: 1 }, layer: "above"
  });
  const label = (text, x, y, size) => ({
    xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: x / pw, y: 1 - y / ph,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false,
    text, font: { family: '"Times New Roman", Times, serif', size, color: "#222" }
  });
  layout.shapes.push(rect(left, top, bw, bh, "rgba(255,255,255,.96)"));
  layout.annotations.push(label("Presidents", left + padding, top + padding - 2, 10));
  legendInfo.items.forEach((item, i) => {
    const x = left + padding + Math.floor(i / rows) * column;
    const y = top + padding + title + (i % rows) * row;
    layout.shapes.push(rect(x, y, 10, 10, rgba(item.color, .3)));
    layout.annotations.push(label(item.name, x + 14, y - 2, 10));
  });
}

function buildExportFigure(plot, series) {
  const multiple = series.length > 1;
  const externalColumns = plot.president_legend?.position === "external" && plot.president_legend.columns === 2;
  const insideMode = plot.legend_mode === "inside";
  const margins = { l: 64, r: plot.axis2 ? 68 : 18, t: 62,
    b: insideMode ? 90 : externalColumns ? 225 : multiple ? 175 : 125 };
  const footerLines = [ ...(plot.export_notes || []),
    plot.source_caption || `Source: BCB–SGS · Codes: ${dependencies(plot).join(", ")}. Author’s calculations.` ];
  const footerText = footerLines.map(line => wrappedTitle(resolvePriceBaseText(line, plot, series), 1000 - margins.l - margins.r, 9)).join("<br>");
  margins.b += Math.max(0, footerText.split("<br>").length - 1) * 13;
  const figure = figureFor(plot, series, 1000, { height: 650, margins, forExport: true });
  const exportHeight = figure.layout.height;
  figure.data.slice(0, series.length).forEach(trace => { trace.showlegend = !insideMode && multiple; trace.legend = "legend2"; });
  figure.data.slice(series.length).forEach(trace => { trace.showlegend = !insideMode && !plot.president_legend; trace.legend = "legend"; });
  figure.layout.width = 1000;
  figure.layout.height = exportHeight;
  figure.layout.autosize = false;
  figure.layout.margin = margins;
  figure.layout.showlegend = !insideMode;
  figure.layout.legend = { ...figure.layout.legend, orientation: "h", x: 0, y: -.12,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,1)" };
  if (multiple && !insideMode) figure.layout.legend2 = {
    title: { text: "Indicators", font: { size: 10 } }, orientation: "h",
    x: 0, y: externalColumns ? -.43 : -.25, yanchor: "top", font: { size: 10 }, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,1)",
    bordercolor: "#000", borderwidth: 1
  };
  fixedExportLegend(plot, figure, series);
  figure.layout.annotations.push({
    xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0, y: 0, yshift: insideMode ? -62 : externalColumns ? -205 : multiple ? -145 : -95,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false, font: { size: 9 },
    text: footerText
  });
  return figure;
}

/** Native section disclosures and same-document anchor navigation.
 * The host calls installSectionNavigation() before starting chart observers.
 * No history entries, disclosure clicks, focus rules or storage are replaced.
 */
const sectionNavigationRoots = new WeakSet();
let sectionNavigationScrollRequest = 0;

function sectionGroupForTarget(target, root) {
  let group = typeof target.closest === "function" ?
    target.closest("details.macro-section-group") : null;
  // A section anchor refers to the outer <section>, above its <details>.
  if (!group && target.id?.startsWith("section-")) {
    const candidate = document.getElementById(`group-${target.id.slice(8)}`);
    if (candidate?.matches("details.macro-section-group") && target.contains(candidate)) group = candidate;
  }
  return group && root.contains(group) ? group : null;
}

/** Open the target's section. Return its element, or null for an invalid target.
 * With scroll=true, schedule one post-layout correction of the native scroll.
 */
function openSectionForHash(fragment, scroll = false) {
  const request = scroll ? ++sectionNavigationScrollRequest : 0;
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || typeof fragment !== "string" ||
      !fragment.startsWith("#") || fragment.length < 2) return null;
  let id;
  try { id = decodeURIComponent(fragment.slice(1)); }
  catch (error) { return null; }
  const root = document.getElementById("macro-dashboard");
  const target = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!root || !target || !root.contains(target)) return null;
  const group = sectionGroupForTarget(target, root);
  if (group) group.open = true;
  if (scroll) {
    const correctScroll = () => {
      if (request !== sectionNavigationScrollRequest) return;
      const currentRoot = document.getElementById("macro-dashboard");
      if (!currentRoot?.contains(target) || (group && !group.open)) return;
      if (typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "start", behavior: "auto" });
      }
    };
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function") requestAnimationFrame(correctScroll);
    else correctScroll();
  }
  return target;
}

function sectionAnchorFragment(anchor) {
  const href = anchor.getAttribute("href");
  if (!href) return null;
  if (href.startsWith("#")) return href;
  // Also accept an absolute or relative URL that identifies this same page.
  try {
    const current = new URL(window.location.href);
    const destination = new URL(href, current);
    if (destination.origin !== current.origin || destination.pathname !== current.pathname ||
        destination.search !== current.search) return null;
    return destination.hash || null;
  } catch (error) { return null; }
}

/** Idempotent installation; native anchor handling keeps URL/history semantics. */
function installSectionNavigation() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  const root = document.getElementById("macro-dashboard");
  if (!root || sectionNavigationRoots.has(root)) return false;
  sectionNavigationRoots.add(root);
  root.addEventListener("click", event => {
    if (event.defaultPrevented || (event.button != null && event.button !== 0) ||
        event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
    const element = typeof event.target?.closest === "function" ? event.target : event.target?.parentElement;
    const anchor = element?.closest("a[href]");
    if (!anchor || !root.contains(anchor) || anchor.hasAttribute("download")) return;
    const context = anchor.getAttribute("target");
    if (context && context.toLowerCase() !== "_self") return;
    const fragment = sectionAnchorFragment(anchor);
    if (fragment) openSectionForHash(fragment, true);
    // Do not preventDefault: opening happened before native anchor scrolling.
  }, true);
  const followHash = () => openSectionForHash(window.location.hash, true);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", followHash);
  window.addEventListener("popstate", followHash);
  followHash();
  return true;
}


// Redraw initialized charts when their native section is reopened. Replacing
// an initialization retry removes its previous listener rather than stacking it.
const sectionRedrawHandlers = new Map();
function registerSectionRedraw(plot, root, redraw) {
  const group = root.closest("details.macro-section-group");
  if (!group) return;
  const previous = sectionRedrawHandlers.get(plot.id);
  if (previous) previous.group.removeEventListener("toggle", previous.listener);
  const listener = event => {
    if (event.target !== group || !group.open) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (group.open && sectionRedrawHandlers.get(plot.id)?.listener === listener) redraw();
    });
  };
  group.addEventListener("toggle", listener);
  sectionRedrawHandlers.set(plot.id, { group, listener });
}


const refreshHandlers = new Map();
let refreshTimer;
function registerRefresh(plot, refresh) {
  refreshHandlers.set(plot.id, refresh);
  if (refreshTimer) return;
  const poll = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") return;
    for (const update of refreshHandlers.values()) void update();
  };
  refreshTimer = setInterval(poll, 60000);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", poll);
}

async function initializePlot(plot) {
  const root = document.getElementById(`panel-${plot.id}`);
  const chart = document.getElementById(`chart-${plot.id}`);
  const status = document.getElementById(`status-${plot.id}`);
  const button = document.getElementById(`download-${plot.id}`);
  const codes = dependencies(plot);
  const raw = Object.fromEntries(codes.map(code => [code, cachedSeries(code)]));
  let series;
  let lastDimensions;
  let task = Promise.resolve();
  function enqueue(action) { const next = task.then(action); task = next.catch(() => {}); return next; }
  async function draw(nextSeries) {
    const mobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
    const width = chart.clientWidth;
    if (width < 120 || root.closest("details.macro-section-group")?.open === false) {
      series = nextSeries;
      return;
    }
    const height = mobile ? 340 : 312;
    const figure = figureFor(plot, nextSeries, width, { mobile, height });
    root.style.setProperty("--macro-plot-top", `${figure.layout.margin.t}px`);
    chart.style.height = `${figure.layout.height}px`;
    await Plotly.react(chart, figure.data, figure.layout, figure.config);
    series = nextSeries;
    if (plot.mobile_margins) {
      for (const heading of root.querySelectorAll(".macro-plot-title, .macro-plot-subtitle")) {
        heading.style.paddingLeft = `${figure.layout.margin.l}px`;
        heading.style.paddingRight = `${figure.layout.margin.r}px`;
      }
    }
    if (plot.subtitle?.includes("{priceBase}") || plot.subtitle?.includes("{lastYear}")) {
      const subtitle = document.getElementById(`subtitle-${plot.id}`) || root.querySelector(".macro-plot-subtitle");
      if (subtitle) subtitle.textContent = resolvePriceBaseText(plot.subtitle, plot, series);
    }
    for (const target of root.querySelectorAll("[data-price-base]")) target.textContent = resolvedPriceBase(plot, series);
    lastDimensions = { width, height: figure.layout.height, mobile };
    fillSidebar(plot, series);
    if (figure.legendInfo.inside) fillInsideBoxes(plot, figure.legendInfo);
    else fillPresidents(plot, figure.legendInfo);
    chart.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
  }
  registerSectionRedraw(plot, root, () => {
    if (series) void enqueue(() => draw(series)).catch(() => {});
  });
  try {
    const missing = codes.filter(code => !Array.isArray(raw[code]) || !raw[code].length);
    if (missing.length) {
      status.textContent = codes.some(isPublicCode) ? "Loading data from the source API…" : codes.some(isIpeaCode) ? "Loading data from Ipeadata…" : "Loading data from the Central Bank of Brazil…";
      status.hidden = false;
      await Promise.all(missing.map(freshSeries));
      for (const code of codes) raw[code] = cachedSeries(code);
    }
    await loadPlotly();
    await enqueue(() => draw(buildSeries(plot, raw)));
    status.hidden = true;
    button.disabled = false;
    button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      button.disabled = true;
      status.hidden = true;
      try {
        await enqueue(async () => {
          const figure = buildExportFigure(plot, series);
          const exportHeight = figure.layout.height;
          const last = series.flatMap(trace => trace.points).map(point => point[0]).sort().at(-1);
          const downloadFigure = { data: figure.data, layout: figure.layout, config: figure.config };
          const source = codes.some(isPublicCode) ? "public-api" : codes.some(isIpeaCode) ? "ipeadata" : "sgs";
          const identifiers = codes.map(code => String(code).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "_")).join("-");
          await Plotly.downloadImage(downloadFigure, { format: "png", filename: `${plot.id}-${source}-${identifiers}-${last.slice(0, 7)}`,
            width: 1000, height: exportHeight, scale: 2 });
        });
      } catch (error) { status.textContent = "Unable to download the figure. Please try again."; status.hidden = false; }
      finally { button.disabled = false; }
    });
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
      let scheduled = false;
      const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        const mobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
        if (!series || !lastDimensions || (Math.abs(chart.clientWidth - lastDimensions.width) < 1 &&
            Math.abs(chart.clientHeight - lastDimensions.height) < 1 && mobile === lastDimensions.mobile)) return;
        if (scheduled) return;
        scheduled = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          scheduled = false;
          void enqueue(() => draw(series)).catch(() => {});
        });
      });
      observer.observe(chart);
    }
    let refreshing = false, lastAttempt = 0, lastAttemptCycle;
    const refresh = async () => {
      const cycle = monthlyUpdateCycle();
      if (refreshing || codes.every(code => refreshedCycles.get(code) === cycle)) return;
      if (lastAttemptCycle === cycle && Date.now() - lastAttempt < 300000) return;
      refreshing = true;
      lastAttempt = Date.now();
      lastAttemptCycle = cycle;
      try {
        await Promise.all(codes.map(freshSeries));
        await enqueue(async () => {
          const nextSeries = buildSeries(plot, currentRaw);
          const signature = values => JSON.stringify(values.map(trace => [trace.points, trace.priceBase]));
          if (signature(nextSeries) !== signature(series)) await draw(nextSeries);
        });
      } catch (error) { /* Keep the last complete figure; the shared poll retries. */ }
      finally { refreshing = false; }
    };
    registerRefresh(plot, refresh);
    void refresh();
  } catch (error) {
    chart.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
    status.textContent = "Unable to load the chart. Please reload the page.";
    status.hidden = false;
    let lastAttempt = Date.now(), retrying = false;
    registerRefresh(plot, async () => {
      if (retrying || Date.now() - lastAttempt < 300000) return;
      lastAttempt = Date.now(); retrying = true;
      try { await initializePlot(plot); } finally { retrying = false; }
    });
  }
}

function municipalNumber(value,decimals=2) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value.toLocaleString("en-US",{minimumFractionDigits:decimals,maximumFractionDigits:decimals}) : "No data";
}
function municipalDomain(values) {
  const valid=Object.values(values).filter(value=>typeof value==="number" && Number.isFinite(value));
  if (!valid.length) throw new Error("No numeric municipal values.");
  valid.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const middle=Math.floor(valid.length/2);
  const median=valid.length%2 ? valid[middle] : (valid[middle-1]+valid[middle])/2;
  return {min:valid[0],median,max:valid[valid.length-1],count:valid.length};
}
function municipalColourPosition(value,domain,transform="linear") {
  if (value===null || value===undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
  const bounded=Math.max(domain.min,Math.min(domain.max,value));
  if (bounded===domain.median) return .5;
  const convert=transform==="log1p" ? Math.log1p : number=>number;
  const lo=convert(domain.min),mid=convert(domain.median),hi=convert(domain.max),point=convert(bounded);
  if (bounded<domain.median) return mid===lo ? .5 : .5*(point-lo)/(mid-lo);
  return hi===mid ? .5 : .5+.5*(point-mid)/(hi-mid);
}
function municipalRGB(position,reverse=false) {
  if (position===null || !Number.isFinite(position)) return `rgb(${MUNICIPAL_COLOURS.missing.join(",")})`;
  const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,reverse ? 1-position : position));
  const side=p<=.5 ? MUNICIPAL_COLOURS.red : MUNICIPAL_COLOURS.green,t=Math.abs(p-.5)*2;
  return `rgb(${MUNICIPAL_COLOURS.neutral.map((value,i)=>Math.round(value*(1-t)+side[i]*t)).join(",")})`;
}
function municipalCode(geometry) {return String(geometry.id ?? geometry.properties?.codarea ?? "");}
function validMunicipalCode(code,names=MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS) {
  return typeof code==="string" && /^\d{7}$/.test(code) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(names,code);
}
function validMunicipalUF(uf) {return uf==="BR" || MUNICIPAL_UFS.some(item=>item[0]===uf);}
function municipalDimensions(width,mobile=false,exported=false) {
  const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(width)),left=mobile?8:12,right=mobile?8:12,top=exported?66:6;
  const plotWidth=Math.max(1,w-left-right),mapHeight=exported?520:Math.round(Math.max(220,Math.min(mobile?340:400,plotWidth*.95)));
  const footerY=top+mapHeight+24;
  return {width:w,height:top+mapHeight+(exported?78:10),left,right,top,plotWidth,mapHeight,footerY};
}
function municipalLegendPlacement(bounds,dims,mobile=false,exported=false) {
  const width=88,barWidth=12,minHeight=mobile?74:100;
  const maximum=Math.min(exported?180:mobile?120:150,dims.mapHeight*.34);
  const intersects=box=>bounds.some(b=>b[0][0]<box.right+3&&b[1][0]>box.left-3&&b[0][1]<box.bottom+3&&b[1][1]>box.top-3);
  for(const fraction of [.56,.61,.66,.71]) {
    const x=dims.left+2,y=dims.top+dims.mapHeight*fraction;
    const height=Math.min(maximum,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-y-12);
    if(height<minHeight)continue;
    const box={left:x-2,right:x+width,top:y-9,bottom:y+height+9};
    if(!intersects(box))return {x,y,height,barWidth,labelX:x+barWidth+7,box,mode:"inside-lower-left",mapLeft:dims.left};
  }
  // Some individual states occupy their lower-left corner. A reserved lateral
  // strip keeps the legend readable while the same undistorted map is refitted.
  const x=dims.left+2,height=Math.min(maximum,dims.mapHeight-24),y=dims.top+(dims.mapHeight-height)/2;
  return {x,y,height,barWidth,labelX:x+barWidth+7,box:{left:x-2,right:x+width,top:y-9,bottom:y+height+9},mode:"reserved-left",mapLeft:dims.left+width+12};
}
function municipalGeometry(libraries,topology,names,uf,width,mobile=false,exported=false) {
  const object=topology.objects.municipalities;
  const geometries=object.geometries.filter(g=>validMunicipalCode(municipalCode(g),names) && (uf==="BR" || names[municipalCode(g)][1]===uf));
  if (!geometries.length) throw new Error("No boundaries for this state.");
  const selected={type:"GeometryCollection",geometries},features=libraries.topojson.feature(topology,selected).features;
  features.forEach(feature=>{feature.id=municipalCode(feature);});
  const dims=municipalDimensions(width,mobile,exported);
  const collection={type:"FeatureCollection",features};
  const projection=libraries.d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[dims.left+6,dims.top+6],[dims.width-dims.right-6,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-6]],collection);
  const path=libraries.d3.geoPath(projection).digits(2);

      const script=document.createElement("script");script.src=url;script.crossOrigin="anonymous";

    });

      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js",()=>!!window.d3?.geoMercator),
      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js",()=>!!window.topojson?.feature),
      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js",()=>!!window.fflate?.gunzipSync)

    if (ids?.length!==Object.keys(MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS).length || ids.some(code=>!validMunicipalCode(code))) throw new Error("Municipal data and boundaries do not match.");
    return {libraries:{d3:window.d3,topojson:window.topojson},topology};
  })().catch(error=>{municipalLibraryPromise=undefined;throw error;});
  return municipalLibraryPromise;
}

    svg.append(text(dims.left,dims.footerY,source,"start",10));
    svg.append(text(dims.left,dims.footerY+15,"Boundaries: IBGE 2022. Median reference: one observation per municipality with data.","start",10));
    svg.append(text(dims.left,dims.footerY+30,field.key==="pbf"?"Absolute benefit counts; log(1 + count) colour spacing. Green = fewer; red = more.":field.key==="gdpMunicipal"?"Nominal BRL; colourbar in BRL billion; log(1 + BRL) colour spacing. Red = lower; green = higher.":"Linear colour spacing on each side of the median; red = lower; green = higher.","start",10));
  }
  return {svg,domain,available,total:geometry.paths.length};
}
function bootMunicipalMaps() {
  const views=new Map(),requested=new Set();let resources=null,uf="BR",selected=null,pinned=null,lastLibraryAttempt=0;
  try {const saved=sessionStorage.getItem("macro-municipal-uf-v1");if(validMunicipalUF(saved))uf=saved;} catch(_) {}
  const names=MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS,codes=new Set(Object.keys(names));
  const controller=createMunicipalDataController({cycleFor:monthlyUpdateCycle,monthLimitFor:observationMonthLimit,seedRows:names,seedVersions:MUNICIPAL_SEED_VERSIONS,geometryCodes:codes,onUpdate:layers=>{
    for(const field of MUNICIPAL_MAPS){const view=views.get(field.id);if(!view)continue;const previous=view.layer;view.layer=layers[field.key];updateLabels(view);if(previous?.values!==view.layer.values||previous?.year!==view.layer.year){view.dirty=true;draw(view);}}
  }});
  const initial=controller.snapshot();
  function updateLabels(view) {
    const {field,layer,root}=view;
    root.querySelector(".macro-plot-subtitle").textContent=municipalSubtitle(field,layer.year);
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-map-year]").forEach(el=>{el.textContent=String(layer.year);});
    const text=view.loadError ? "The map could not load. A retry will run automatically; the last valid data remain available." : municipalLayerStatus(layer),status=root.querySelector(".macro-status");status.textContent=text;status.hidden=!text;
    const coverage=layer.coverage,latest=root.querySelector("[data-map-latest]");
    latest.textContent=`Reference: ${field.key==="pbf"?"December ":""}${layer.year}. ${municipalNumber(coverage.available,0)} of ${municipalNumber(coverage.geometry,0)} reference territories have data.${coverage.excluded?" "+municipalNumber(coverage.excluded,0)+" additional source territories fall outside the 2022 boundaries.":""} ${layer.checkedAt?"API last checked "+layer.checkedAt.slice(0,10)+".":"Embedded snapshot verified "+MUNICIPAL_SNAPSHOT_DATE+"."}`;
  }
  function showSelection(code,announce=false) {
    selected=validMunicipalCode(code)&& (uf==="BR"||names[code][1]===uf)?code:null;
    for(const view of views.values()) {
      const row=selected?names[selected]:null,path=view.geometry?.paths.find(item=>item.code===selected)?.path||"";
      view.chart.querySelector("[data-map-selection]")?.setAttribute("d",path);
      const value=row?view.layer.values[selected]:null;
      const detail=row?`${row[0]}, ${row[1]} · ${municipalNumber(value,view.field.decimals)} ${view.field.unit}${view.field.key==="pbf"?" "+view.layer.year:" ("+view.layer.year+")"}`:"Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.";
      view.root.querySelector("[data-map-detail]").textContent=detail;
      if(announce)view.root.querySelector("[data-map-announcement]").textContent=detail;
    }
  }
  function draw(view) {
    if(view.root.closest("details.macro-section-group")?.open===false)return;
    const width=view.chart.clientWidth;if(width<120)return;
    const mobile=window.matchMedia("(max-width:600px)").matches,key=`${width}:${mobile}:${uf}`;
    // Reserve the final figure height before loading its libraries, keeping
    // contents navigation stable when another map lies above the target.
    view.chart.style.height=`${municipalDimensions(width,mobile).height}px`;
    if(!resources||!requested.has(view.field.id))return;
    if(!view.dirty&&view.sizeKey===key)return;
    view.geometry=municipalGeometry(resources.libraries,resources.topology,names,uf,width,mobile);
    const figure=buildMunicipalSVG(document,view.field,view.layer,view.geometry,names,uf);
    view.chart.replaceChildren(figure.svg);view.chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");view.chart.style.height=`${view.geometry.dims.height}px`;
    view.root.querySelector("[data-map-coverage]").textContent=`${uf==="BR"?"Brazil":MUNICIPAL_UFS.find(item=>item[0]===uf)[1]+" ("+uf+")"} · ${municipalNumber(figure.available,0)} / ${municipalNumber(figure.total,0)} municipalities with data`;
    view.sizeKey=key;view.dirty=false;view.domain=figure.domain;view.button.disabled=!!view.exporting;
    showSelection(selected);
  }
  function setUF(next) {
    uf=validMunicipalUF(next)?next:"BR";selected=null;pinned=null;
    try{sessionStorage.setItem("macro-municipal-uf-v1",uf);}catch(_){}
    for(const view of views.values()){view.select.value=uf;view.dirty=true;draw(view);}showSelection(null);
  }
  async function start(field) {
    requested.add(field.id);const view=views.get(field.id);if(!view)return;
    if(!resources){
      lastLibraryAttempt=Date.now();
      try{resources=await loadMunicipalLibraries();for(const item of views.values()){item.loadError=false;updateLabels(item);}}catch(_){view.loadError=true;view.chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");updateLabels(view);return;}
    }
    for(const item of views.values())draw(item);
    void controller.refresh();
  }
  for(const field of MUNICIPAL_MAPS) {
    const root=document.getElementById(`panel-${field.id}`),chart=document.getElementById(`chart-${field.id}`),select=root.querySelector("[data-map-state]"),button=document.getElementById(`download-${field.id}`);
    const view={field,root,chart,select,button,layer:initial[field.key],dirty:true};views.set(field.id,view);
    for(const[abbr,name]of MUNICIPAL_UFS){const option=document.createElement("option");option.value=abbr;option.textContent=`${name} (${abbr})`;select.append(option);}select.value=uf;
    select.addEventListener("change",()=>setUF(select.value));
    chart.addEventListener("pointerover",event=>{const path=event.target.closest?.("[data-municipality]");if(path&&window.matchMedia("(hover:hover)").matches)showSelection(path.getAttribute("data-municipality"));});
    chart.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>showSelection(pinned));
    chart.addEventListener("click",event=>{const path=event.target.closest?.("[data-municipality]");if(path){const code=path.getAttribute("data-municipality");pinned=pinned===code?null:code;showSelection(pinned,true);}});
    registerSectionRedraw(field,root,()=>draw(view));
    if(typeof ResizeObserver!=="undefined"){let scheduled=false;const observer=new ResizeObserver(()=>{if(scheduled)return;scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{scheduled=false;draw(view);});});observer.observe(chart);}
    button.addEventListener("click",async()=>{
      if(!resources||view.exporting)return;view.exporting=true;button.disabled=true;
      const exportUF=uf,exportLayer=view.layer;
      try {
        const geometry=municipalGeometry(resources.libraries,resources.topology,names,exportUF,1000,false,true);
        const {svg}=buildMunicipalSVG(document,field,exportLayer,geometry,names,exportUF,true);
        const markup=new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([markup],{type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}));
        try{
          const image=new Image();await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=reject;image.src=url;});
          const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=geometry.dims.width*2;canvas.height=geometry.dims.height*2;const context=canvas.getContext("2d");context.fillStyle="#fff";context.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);context.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
          const blob=await new Promise(resolve=>canvas.toBlob(resolve,"image/png"));if(!blob)throw new Error("PNG export unavailable.");
          const png=URL.createObjectURL(blob);try{const link=document.createElement("a");link.href=png;link.download=`${field.id}-${exportLayer.year}-${exportUF.toLowerCase()}.png`;document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();}finally{setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(png),30000);}
        }finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
      }catch(_){const status=root.querySelector(".macro-status");status.textContent="PNG export could not be completed. Please try again.";status.hidden=false;}finally{view.exporting=false;button.disabled=false;}
    });
    updateLabels(view);draw(view);
  }
  void controller.hydrate();
  registerRefresh({id:"municipal-maps"},async()=>{if(!requested.size)return;void controller.refresh();if(!resources&&Date.now()-lastLibraryAttempt>=300000)void start(MUNICIPAL_MAPS.find(field=>requested.has(field.id)));});
  if(typeof IntersectionObserver==="undefined")MUNICIPAL_MAPS.forEach(field=>void start(field));
  else{
    const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{for(const entry of entries)if(entry.isIntersecting){const field=MUNICIPAL_MAPS.find(item=>`panel-${item.id}`===entry.target.id);if(field)void start(field);observer.unobserve(entry.target);}},{rootMargin:"650px 0px"});
    for(const view of views.values())observer.observe(view.root);
  }
  return {controller,views,setUF,showSelection,start};
}


function boot() {
  installSectionNavigation();
  bootMunicipalMaps();
  const initialized = new Set();
  function start(plot) {
    if (initialized.has(plot.id)) return;
    initialized.add(plot.id);
    void initializePlot(plot);
  }
  if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") PLOTS.forEach(start);
  else {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const plot = PLOTS.find(item => `panel-${item.id}` === entry.target.id);
        if (plot) start(plot);
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { rootMargin: "650px 0px" });
    PLOTS.forEach(plot => observer.observe(document.getElementById(`panel-${plot.id}`)));
    start(PLOTS[0]);
  }
}

  MANIFEST, SEEDS, addGaps, dateLabel, monthlyUpdateCycle, observationMonthLimit, buildExportFigure,
  isIpeaCode, parseIpeaRows, fetchIpeaSeries, cacheKey, cachedSeries, freshSeries,
  currentRaw, refreshedCycles, requestPromises, sourceVersions, fetchIpeaVersion, resolvedPriceBase, resolvePriceBaseText,
  isRegionalIpeaSeries, API_SOURCES, PUBLIC_API_SOURCES, isPublicCode, parsePublicPayload, fetchPublicSeries, parseRAISSchooling };
if (typeof document !== "undefined") boot();
